A.claim: Literature state (primary-source, U130): among signatures with all exponents >= 3, the fully solved families are (3,3,n) n<=10^9, (n,n,3) n>=3, (n,n,n). Hence (4,4,3) is solved; (4,4,5), (4,4,7), (4,6,3), every (2m,2n,r odd) with m != n, (3,5,7), (5,5,7) are open. A Jev screen of all 45 pool candidates found NONE subsumed by these (max subsumed 0.2

B.claim: No Beal counterexample of signature (2m,2n,3) with m>=4 and n>=4. Even m or even n: signature (4,2n,3) / (2m,4,3), excluded by BCDY 2015 Thm 1. Both odd (>=5): C odd forces a+bi=(u+vi)^3 in Z[i]; on whichever side 3 does not divide the parameter, (s^2)^m+(-eps t)^m=3v^2 with m odd, forbidden by Bennett-Skinner 2004 Thm 1.1 (C=3).
